title: Tag
description: Product tag for labeling and categorizing items with keywords. Tags help with search, filtering, and organization. Tracks tag name, usage statistics, and visual styling.

name.description: Tag name or keyword (e.g., sale, new, featured, organic, limited-edition)

slug.description: URL-friendly version of the tag name for use in web addresses

description.description: Brief description explaining what products this tag applies to

color.description: Hex color code or color name for visual tag styling and display

usage_count.description: Number of products currently tagged with this tag

created_at.description: Timestamp when the tag was created
